tickets.title: Set the loudness budget and ducking rules
tickets.description: Day one. Mixing is where amateur projects audibly lose it, and retrofitting a mix is miserable.

tickets.title: Six-layer ambience mixer
tickets.description: Biome bed, time of day, weather, proximity, one-shots, territory. Mixed live.

tickets.title: Author biome ambience beds (6)
tickets.description: Long slow loops. One of the five things that makes a biome a biome rather than a texture swap.

tickets.title: Time-of-day ambience layer
tickets.description: Dawn chorus, night insects, the specific quiet of pre-dawn.

tickets.title: Weather audio driven from the climate fields
tickets.description: Per-region from phase 4 output, not a global roll.

tickets.title: Proximity and spatialised one-shot layers
tickets.description: Water, cliffs, settlements, ruins; distant cracks, rockfalls, wingbeats.

tickets.title: Territory audio layer
tickets.description: Work-bells, patrol horns, or nothing. Crossing a border becomes audible before it becomes visible.

tickets.title: Artemis Withdrew ambience suppression
tickets.description: Remove the entire biological layer. Costs nothing to implement and will be the most talked-about thing in the game.

tickets.title: Event-driven music system
tickets.description: Music arrives at vistas, discovery, combat and death, then stops. Not a continuous bed.

tickets.title: Compose modular stems with per-axiom instrumentation
tickets.description: The seed picks the palette, not the melody. Same composition budget, six sensory identities.

tickets.title: Audible settlement signatures for navigation
tickets.description: Bells, mills, surf, mine machinery with long falloff. When visibility fails, sound still navigates.

tickets.title: Pressure-driven ambience degradation
tickets.description: As the front approaches, birds thin then vanish, a low drone rises, the one-shot pool loses its living entries.

tickets.title: Outdoor reverb approximation from terrain
tickets.description: Occasional raycasts; cliff walls and canyons return sound. Most of the map in an Unbinding world.

tickets.title: Mechanical weather effects
tickets.description: Rain masks sound both ways, fog defeats landmark navigation, night is dangerous, cold gates regions.

tickets.title: Per-axiom global colour grade and per-biome post volumes
tickets.description: The cheapest way to make mixed-source assets read as one world. Doc 16.
